record.paper: Long cycles in vertex transitive digraphs

dossier_meta.paper: Long cycles in vertex transitive digraphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Does there exist $C>0$ such that in any vertex transitive digraph, the length of a longest path is by at most a factor of $C$ larger than the length of a longest directed cycle?
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper asks whether the classical constant-factor relation between longest paths and longest cycles in undirected vertex-transitive graphs has a directed analogue.
